description: Add a `cam stats tokens` retrospective report (mean/median tokens-per-issue from the cycle-tokens stream) and a plan-time, non-gating split advisory keyed on WSJF jobSize.

userStories.title: Pure tokens-per-issue aggregation module
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need a pure module that turns the cycle-tokens event stream into per-issue token totals plus global mean/median so that the report and the advisory can both consume one tested aggregation with no I/O.
acceptanceCriteria: A new pure module src/stats/tokens.ts exports a function that takes the event-log JSONL content (string | null) and returns per-issue orch/worker/total rollups aggregated by cycle-tokens detail.issueNumber, plus global mean and median tokens-per-issue. [oracle: bun test]

Attribution uses the cycle-tokens event exclusively (detail.issueNumber); raw tokens events (which carry only storyId + uuid, no issue key) are never grouped by issue directly and the tokens event schema is not modified. [oracle: bun test]

The result reports unattributed spend as a distinct field (raw tokens spend from cycles that closed with no cycle-tokens marker), rather than silently dropping it or folding it into a per-issue bucket. [oracle: bun test]
Malformed / partial JSONL lines are tolerated (skipped), matching the existing readers in src/commands/journal.ts. [oracle: bun test]
Array indexing and regex/capture-group access in the JSONL parse and in the median computation are guarded (noUncheckedIndexedAccess). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: New file src/stats/tokens.ts + test/stats/tokens.test.ts. CycleTokensEventDetail = { cycleId, issueNumber, orchTokens, workerTokens, total, recordedAt } (src/supervisor/events.ts:346). Model the readers on src/commands/journal.ts (defaultReadEventLog / findLastCycleTokensIdx / extractTokensFromLine, lines 371-434) which already tolerate malformed lines; keep this module pure (string-in / data-out, no fs). Unattributed = sum of raw 'tokens' events minus what the cycle-tokens slices attribute; see issue gotchas (cycles closing without a journal entry leave tokens events unattributed). Do NOT re-add dashboard/budget surfaces (already shipped, CAM-131/US-014).

userStories.title: cam stats tokens command + dispatch wiring
userStories.description: As an operator, I need a `cam stats tokens` command that prints per-issue token spend plus mean/median so that I can see which issues run hot and use that to guide task slicing.
acceptanceCriteria: A new `cam stats tokens` subcommand is wired end-to-end: a 'stats' COMMANDS entry, a paired HELP_REGISTRY entry, and a switch case in index.ts, with the implementation in src/commands/stats.ts. [oracle: grep -q "'stats'" index.ts]

The command reads .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl and renders a human-readable table of per-issue orch/worker/total plus the global mean and median tokens-per-issue, via the US-001 aggregation module. [oracle: bun test]

The output includes exactly one machine-parseable line beginning with CAM_STATS_TOKENS= in the project idiom (cf. CAM_ORCH_BUDGET= in src/commands/orch-budget.ts). [oracle: grep -q 'CAM_STATS_TOKENS=' src/commands/stats.ts]
The report flags unattributed spend rather than silently dropping or misattributing raw tokens events. [oracle: bun test]

The output states explicitly that the orch component of cycle-tokens.total excludes output tokens (the known orch-vs-worker formula asymmetry) and that totals are used as recorded, not recomputed from transcripts. [oracle: grep -q 'output' src/commands/stats.ts]
The command always exits 0 on a missing/empty event log (no data is not an error), mirroring cam orch-budget. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: New file src/commands/stats.ts + test/commands/stats.test.ts; edit index.ts. Command wiring is typecheck-enforced: COMMANDS + HELP_REGISTRY (index.ts:2432-2521) + switch case (index.ts:2531+) must all be added together or typecheck fails (CAM-278/CAM-211). Model the I/O-wiring + machine-line shape on src/commands/orch-budget.ts (injectable write, exit 0 on missing transcript). Inject the write fn and event-log reader for hermetic tests. Formula asymmetry (issue gotcha / journal.ts:410 vs 494): orch total = input+cacheCreation+cacheRead (no output), worker total = all four fields; surface it in prose, do not recompute.

userStories.title: Split-advisory heuristic + plan-split-advisory event kind
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need a pure heuristic plus an event type that decide whether an issue of a given WSJF jobSize is likely to run hot enough to warrant splitting, so that the plan runner can emit a non-gating advisory.
acceptanceCriteria: src/supervisor/events.ts gains a 'plan-split-advisory' WorkerEventKind and a matching detail interface added to the WorkerEventDetail union. [oracle: grep -q 'plan-split-advisory' src/supervisor/events.ts]

A new pure module src/stats/split-advisory.ts exports a function that takes historical { jobSize, total } records plus the current issue's jobSize and generated story count, and computes the projected tokens as the historical mean of the same-jobSize bucket. [oracle: bun test]

The advisory fires only when the projection exceeds ~1.5x the median of that jobSize bucket; it is silent below the threshold and returns no advisory when the bucket has no history (no-data -> no advisory). [oracle: bun test]
The 1.5x multiplier and the jobSize bucketing are code constants in the module; no project.toml config knob is read or added. [oracle: grep -q '1.5' src/stats/split-advisory.ts]
Array indexing and the median computation are guarded (noUncheckedIndexedAccess). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: New file src/stats/split-advisory.ts + test/stats/split-advisory.test.ts; edit src/supervisor/events.ts (kind list ~line 103-138, detail interfaces ~346, WorkerEventDetail union ~496-522). Keep the module pure (no fs/git). jobSize is the WSJF scale from IssueEntry.wsjf.jobSize (src/issues/types.ts:29). The heuristic connects to the lesson prd-size-vs-review-convergence (PRDs >=8-9 stories blow up review): a jobSize bucket whose mean >> median tends to spawn hot issues, so an issue of that jobSize is a split candidate. Include the current story count in the detail so the note can reference it. Reuse the median helper shape from US-001 if convenient (do not couple the modules).

userStories.title: Emit the split advisory at plan-time (non-gating)
userStories.description: As an operator, I need the plan runner to emit a split advisory after PRD generation when the target issue's jobSize historically runs hot, so that I get an early signal to slice the task without the loop ever blocking.
acceptanceCriteria: After PRD generation in the plan runner (runPostPlanActions, src/commands/sidecar.ts), the advisory is computed: current issue jobSize read from the issue spec file (wsjf.jobSize), story count from the generated prd.json userStories length, historical { jobSize, total } records built by joining cycle-tokens per-issue totals with each issue file's jobSize. [oracle: bun test]

When the heuristic fires, a plan-split-advisory event is emitted AND an operator-facing note is delivered (via the existing notify path); when it does not fire or there is no history, nothing is emitted. [oracle: bun test]
The advisory is strictly non-gating: it never changes the plan / post-audit outcome, never throws out of runPostPlanActions, and never fails the loop. [oracle: bun test]
No new project.toml config knob is added; the threshold and bucketing remain the US-003 code constants. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Edit src/commands/sidecar.ts runPostPlanActions (~line 2186-2242): it already parses prd.json for issueNumber and has logEvent + a notify path (makeNotifyOrchestrator). Add the advisory AFTER runPostAuditAction/exitPhaseAfterPlan, wrapped so any read/parse error is swallowed (best-effort, never throws). Read the current issue file via issueFilePath(id) (src/issues/backlog.ts:205) for wsjf.jobSize; read story count from prd.json userStories.length. Build historical records: aggregate cycle-tokens by issueNumber (US-001) then look up each issue file's jobSize. Emit the US-003 'plan-split-advisory' event via o.logEvent and push the operator note. Cover: fires above threshold, silent below, no-data -> no advisory, and a throwing reader still returns normally. Do NOT gate the plan phase.
